func (s *DBTestSuite) TestSingleSegmentOperatorFallback() {
 t := s.T()
 ctx := context.Background()
 flag, err := s.store.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 segment, err := s.store.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 rule, err := s.store.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{
  FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKeys: []string{segment.Key}, Rank: 1,
  SegmentOperator: flipt.SegmentOperator_AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR,
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, rule.SegmentOperator)
 stored, err := s.store.GetRule(ctx, storage.DefaultNamespace, rule.Id)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, segment.Key, stored.SegmentKey)
 assert.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, stored.SegmentOperator)
}
EOF
